# LightStack — Copilot Instructions

iOS strength-training app. Swift + SwiftUI, Supabase backend, multi-provider AI coaching.

## Non-negotiables

- **Swift only.** No Objective-C.
- **SwiftUI only.** No UIKit view controllers. `UIViewRepresentable` is acceptable only when no SwiftUI equivalent exists (e.g. camera capture).
- **No force-unwraps** (`!`) and no force-casts (`as!`). Use `guard let` / `if let`.
- **Never edit `Lightstack.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`.** It is generated by XcodeGen from `project.yml`. Change `project.yml`, then run `xcodegen generate`. Xcode itself sometimes rewrites the pbxproj during a build — discard those changes.
- **Never commit secrets.** API keys live in `Lightstack/Config/Secrets.xcconfig`, which is git-ignored. When adding a new key, add it to `Secrets.xcconfig.template` with an empty value and surface it via `Info.plist` → `Bundle.main.infoDictionary`.

## Architecture

```
Lightstack/
  App/         AppEnvironment (DI container), LightstackApp, RootView, MainTabView
  Core/
    Models/        domain models
    Repositories/  persistence
    Services/      AIServiceManager, SupabaseService, SyncService, ValidationService, …
    Theme/         AppTheme
    Utilities/
  Features/<Feature>/{Models,Services,ViewModels,Views}
LightstackTests/
```

- MVVM. Views stay declarative; logic belongs in a `ViewModel`.
- `AppEnvironment` is the single `ObservableObject` DI container injected at the root. Resolve shared services through it rather than instantiating them in views.
- Feature-local code stays under `Features/<Feature>/`. Promote to `Core/` only when a second feature needs it.

## Conventions

- **Styling:** use `AppTheme` for every color, font, and spacing value. No hardcoded hex, magic numbers, or literal `Color`/`Font` values. Prefer system colors and materials so light/dark mode both work.
- **Logging:** `os.Logger`, never `print`. One logger per type: `Logger(subsystem: "org.lightstack.app", category: "<TypeName>")`.
- **Concurrency:** `async/await`. Annotate UI-touching code `@MainActor`; don't hop with `DispatchQueue.main`.
- **Errors:** surface failures to the user. Never swallow an error, and never persist or cache a result produced by a failed AI call.
- **Dependencies:** no new third-party packages without the owner's explicit approval. Currently approved: Supabase, GoogleSignIn.

## Testing

Unit tests live in `LightstackTests/`, named `<Subject>Tests.swift`. Cover parsing, validation, and view-model logic — the layers that break silently. Add a test file to `project.yml`'s test target, then regenerate.

## Before proposing a change is complete

```bash
DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild build \
  -project Lightstack.xcodeproj -scheme Lightstack \
  -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15 Pro,OS=17.2' -quiet
```

A clean build is the floor, not the bar. "Done" means the feature works end to end — if a flow can't be verified without real credentials or a physical device, say so explicitly rather than implying it was tested.

## Git

- Work branches off `main`; do not commit directly to `main`.
- Commit messages: `<type>: <what changed>` (`feat`, `fix`, `test`, `refactor`, `chore`, `style`).
- Keep generated-file churn and unrelated reformatting out of diffs.
